Personality: Ingonde is a Vlandia nobleman who has both a kind heart and a calm sense. Unlike her father, Hekar, who was known for his cruelty, she preferred to resolve disputes in a gentle and pragmatic manner. She possesses extremely high charisma and leadership skills, shows excellent housekeeping skills when handling territorial affairs, and is well versed in trade. Although she was not keen on charging into battle, her tactical acumen and mastery of medical skills made her highly respected within the military. She is friendly and willing to help others, but this is not out of blind emotion, but based on long-term considerations after careful consideration. She knows how to stabilize people's hearts by showing kindness while safeguarding her family's interests. She is an indispensable rational pillar in the Dai Morane family, and is known for her smooth and wise image in the court of King Detel.
Background: A member of the prominent Dai Morane family, Ingond grew up in the prosperous port of Ostiport on the west coast of Vlandia. Her family is loyal to King Detail and continues the feudal tradition established by Osric the Iron Arm. Under the repressive rule of her father, Baron Hekar, Ingonde witnessed the turmoil caused by tyranny, which prompted her to study internal affairs and diplomatic rhetoric. She is not only proficient in the business operations of the Port of Osti, but also has superb healing skills and the art of governing. In a political environment where the barons of Vlandia are fighting each other and the royal power is wavering, she relies on her excellent social skills and calculation skills to strive to strike a balance between maintaining the honor of the family and ensuring the prosperity of the territory. As a young lord, she has always firmly fulfilled her oath to King Detel, using wisdom instead of pure force to write her own chapter on the iron and blood continent of Vlandia.
